section: Eligibility for a new PMUY connection
source_authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
text: For a new connection under PMUY Ujjwala, the official page states that the applicant must be a woman aged 18 years or older. No other LPG connection from any Oil Marketing Company may exist in the same household. The adult woman must belong to a poor household and submit the prescribed deprivation declaration.
title: PMUY Ujjwala - eligibility

section: Documents for a new PMUY connection
source_authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
text: Documents needed for a new PMUY Ujjwala connection are listed on the official page: the KYC application form; the applicant's Aadhaar as identity proof; address proof only when the current address differs from the Aadhaar address; a state ration card or another state-government document certifying family composition; Aadhaar copies of the applicant and adult family members named in that family-composition document; bank-account details through a passbook copy or cancelled cheque; and the prescribed deprivation declaration. Migrant applicants may use the prescribed Annexure I self-declaration where the page permits it for address or family composition.
title: PMUY Ujjwala - required documents

section: How to apply for a new PMUY connection
source_authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
text: The official Ujjwala page says an eligible applicant may apply to an LPG distributor of her choice by submitting the application to the distributor, or may submit a request through the official online portal. The page also provides the KYC form, Unified PAHAL (DBTL) Joining Form and declaration format for a new connection.
title: PMUY Ujjwala - application route
